# Scout35 closed negative handoff

Status: **NO_PROMOTION / NO_ADMISSION / ZERO_RESERVES**.
This bounded lane contributes no paper and does not complete the open seat.

Two literal definitions; zero scientific pilots. D1, Vieta sum/product
feedback, is identical to the old algebraic C8 and was rejected before
execution. D2, unsigned Boolean Fourier-support feedback, is a close
zero-frequency variant of old WZS. Its exact adapter and limited orbit
facts are proved, including all boundary dimensions.

The strongest narrower D2 conclusion is that the full set $V$ is the
unique maximum-fibre target for every $d\ge1$; for $d=0$ both targets tie.
This does not evaluate that maximum in general or supply the missing
full-carrier temporal/recurrent atlas. The affine-subspace two-cycle
family is exactly classical orthogonal complement and earns no fresh
temporal credit. The required two independent axes remain
**NOT CURRENTLY JUSTIFIED**. No larger box or reserve is proposed.

## Controlling artifacts

- [INTAKE.md](INTAKE.md): both literal definitions, final budget and decisions.
- [PROOF_PACKAGE.md](PROOF_PACKAGE.md): self-contained deductions and exact gaps.
- [SOURCE_AND_HISTORY.md](SOURCE_AND_HISTORY.md): primary-source access boundaries,
  original-only retrieval, explicit historical adapters and preserved failures.
- [DIRECT_ORIGINAL_INPUTS.json](DIRECT_ORIGINAL_INPUTS.json): five named physical
  original snapshots with literal path/old-hash roles.
- [CONTROL_CAPTURE.json](CONTROL_CAPTURE.json): initial STATE/PIPE/GIT copies,
  exact old pins and the disclosed pre-copy orchestration typo.
- [CLOSURE_AUDIT.actual.json](CLOSURE_AUDIT.actual.json): actual documentary checks
  of fixed history pins, snapshots, failed/corrected search evidence and payload.
- [MANIFEST.sha256](MANIFEST.sha256): complete nonself payload manifest.

The final audit covers documentary integrity, not mathematical validation,
source/value approval, independent manuscript review or new numerical
execution. No scripts in this lane implement either candidate map.
The initial auditor stopped on an incorrect count of changed path strings;
its source, initial manifest and actual failures are retained. The separate
v2 auditor corrects exactly that count and is used for the final check.
Hand-written dimension-zero/one boundary calculations are deductive proof,
not new finite-pilot runs.

The manifest excludes exactly itself and the final audit wrapper, which
cannot self-pin; the audit output pins the manifest. All other owned
payload files, including source-return evidence, snapshots, scripts and
failed search provenance, are covered. The auditor traverses only the
owned immediate directory and its three named payload subdirectories;
historical inputs are read exclusively from fixed exact-path records.

All writes are confined to this lane. The private-sync preparation,
terminal packages, central indices, paper/review/QA files and Git were
not modified. Root owns any index integration and synchronization.
The one remaining seat stays open. No children, external reviewer,
external manuscript upload or new number. **HOLD_EXTERNAL**.

SOURCE_AND_HISTORY.md.text:
# Scout35 source, collision and evidence boundary

This is a bounded author desk check for a rejected lane, not a completed
global novelty audit. The local lane owner authored the proof deductions;
no process-separated manuscript review is claimed.

## Exact historical retrieval

Two literal/mechanism searches used 537 explicit original text files each.
The selected paths and pre/post full-byte pins are in
[search 01](HISTORY_SEARCH_01.actual.json) and
[search 02](HISTORY_SEARCH_02.actual.json).
The scope is exactly:

- immediate paper originals at
  `papers/<57..207-slug>/{README.md,main.tex,PROOF_PACKAGE.md}`;
- immediate Markdown originals of eligible current-batch scouting lanes,
  with FTH/OFS and active Scout33--35 directories and P208/P209-named files
  excluded by the saved selector;
- three named immediate historical ledgers:
  `BREADTH_LEDGER.md`,
  `TITLE_COLLISION_INVENTORY.md` and
  `KILL_LEDGER.md`.

There was no recursive search/hash of descendant QA, frozen review,
build or runtime artifacts. This is deliberately not a claim to have
searched every historic word or every excluded paper.

Query 01 searched Vieta, elementary-symmetric and coefficient-feedback
wording. Query 02 searched Walsh/Fourier support and adjacent vocabulary.
Both successful `rg` calls returned exit zero with blank stderr;
their exact command, environment, stdout and unchanged input maps are
preserved in the actual JSON records.

The original search script used the nonexistent path
`/usr/bin/rg` and failed before starting an `rg` child.
[The failed actual record](HISTORY_SEARCH_01.failed.actual.json) and
[the original script](search_originals.py) are retained. The separately
named [v2 script](search_originals_v2.py) changes only three literal
tool-path occurrences on two lines to the actually resolved bundled `rg` binary.
[The full actual diff](SEARCHER_DIFF.actual.json) records exit one as the
normal “files differ” result; it is not a failed scientific run.

The first closure auditor incorrectly checked for two path occurrences,
confusing two changed lines with three occurrences, and stopped. Its
original source, initial manifest and both actual failure invocations are
retained in `audit_closure.py`, `MANIFEST.initial_before_audit_failure.sha256`
and `CLOSURE_AUDIT.failed.actual.json`. The separately named
`audit_closure_v2.py` corrects only that literal count from two to three.
The final manifest covers all failed and corrected provenance. This was
a documentary assertion error, not a numerical test or mathematical finding.

## Direct original adapters

[DIRECT_ORIGINAL_INPUTS.json](DIRECT_ORIGINAL_INPUTS.json) records the exact
original path, old hash, byte size and physical snapshot for five named
originals. The four current-batch originals occur in the frozen 537-file
search set. The algebraic SCOUT is one additional explicitly targeted
original, found by the pointer in the old matrix intake; it was not
silently added to the completed search's selection count.

The old algebraic SCOUT's C8 row and Section 5 state precisely
$(x,y)\mapsto(x+y,xy)$ on $\mathbb F_q^2$.
The complete document was read; this identity is the D1 rejection premise.
Its historical pilot results remain old results and were not rerun.

The old eleventh INTAKE defines signed-Walsh zero-set feedback.
Its WZS proof section was read through the inverse/disposition boundary.
The complete eleventh source note was read for scope, not as a substitute
for fresh primary-source access. The full-matrix MSP intake was read in
full for the scalar-C8 adapter. Whole-file snapshots do not assert that
the unrelated ACP proof in the shared eleventh proof file was fully read.

D2's exact relation to WZS is derived from
$W_A(\xi)=N1_{\xi=0}-2\widehat{1_A}(\xi)$ in our proof package.
It is an output-complement relation with empty/balanced zero-frequency
exceptions, not a transferred full temporal theorem. Orthogonal
complement on subspaces is fully deducted; the maximum-fibre location
comes from elementary parity and a central-binomial upper bound.
Neither is labelled new ownership.

## Actual external desk search

Six queries were issued in two calls:

1. `"Walsh" "support" "iteration" Boolean Fourier transform subset`.
2. `"Fourier support" "indicator" "dynamics" finite group`.
3. `"Walsh transform" "zero" "feedback" Boolean`.
4. `"support of the Fourier transform" "Boolean" iteration`,
   restricted to arxiv.org.
5. `"Fourier support" "iteration" indicator finite group`.
6. `"spectral characterization" "correlation-immune" Xiao Massey 1988`.

Actual returned text, including irrelevant hits and access failures, is in
[sources/WEB_01.actual.txt](sources/WEB_01.actual.txt),
[sources/WEB_02.actual.txt](sources/WEB_02.actual.txt) and
[sources/WEB_03.actual.txt](sources/WEB_03.actual.txt).
Query returns are not full-paper reads or exhaustive database coverage.
No current-six-month systematic review or specialist search is claimed.

The directly inspected primary body was Sanyal,
*Fourier Sparsity and Dimension*, Theory of Computing 15 (11), 2019,
DOI 10.4086/toc.2019.v015a011: Introduction/Definition 1.1 and adjacent
normalization discussion, including the footnote permitting indicator
functions. It defines static Fourier support; its iterative proof
procedure restricts functions along parity queries, not our support
feedback map. This supports classical terminology only and supplies no
claimed ownership decision for our literal dynamics.
[Official full text](https://theoryofcomputing.org/articles/v015a011/v015a011.pdf).

The author-archive Xiao--Massey PDF first returned a three-page metadata
record, but the subsequent body request timed out. This lane therefore
does not claim a fresh body read or import its theorem; the old lane's
separate successful body read is only an old provenance fact.
[Author archive](https://www.isiweb.ee.ethz.ch/archive/massey_pub/pdf/BI431.pdf).

The MDPI paper *Discovering Non-Linear Boolean Functions by Evolving Walsh
Transforms with Genetic Programming* returned indexed excerpts about
spectral inversion and random handling of zeros; the direct page request
failed. These excerpts describe an adjacent representation/search method,
not a demonstrated identical autonomous map. No full-body theorem or
ownership result is imported.
[Publisher page](https://www.mdpi.com/1999-4893/16/11/499).

Carlet's chapter, a 2026 plateaued-function publisher result, and several
cryptographic feedback papers were returned as leads, not audited sources.
Secondary aggregators and discussion sites are not premises of any result.

## Scope of the closure

The project skill caused early rejection and evidence preservation.
The idea-creator skill was used only for local bounded candidate triage,
research-lit for the above desk source check, and proof-writer for the
explicit split between proved narrower facts and the unproved target.
No skill-default external brainstorm/reviewer, GPU work, confirmation
loop, root-level output, upload or publication was performed.

The control snapshots were preserved before model reading. If current
STATE/PIPE/GIT later changes, the literal original-path plus old-hash key
resolves to its original physical snapshot, never to a freshly repinned
index. The closure auditor checks these exact roles and records current
equality or change without altering central files.

**NO_PROMOTION / NO_ADMISSION / ZERO_RESERVES / HOLD_EXTERNAL**.
